)

CREATE TABLE fs_node_revisions (
    revision INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,

    path TEXT NOT NULL,
    kind TEXT NOT NULL,
    content TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    etag TEXT NOT NULL,
    metadata_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    deleted INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (deleted IN (0, 1))
)

CREATE TABLE fs_nodes (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    path TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    kind TEXT NOT NULL,
    content TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    etag TEXT NOT NULL,
    metadata_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
    parent_id INTEGER,
    name TEXT
)

CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE fs_nodes_fts USING fts5(
    path,
    title,
    content,
    tokenize = 'trigram case_sensitive 0'
)
CREATE TABLE 'fs_nodes_fts_config'(k PRIMARY KEY, v) WITHOUT ROWID
CREATE TABLE 'fs_nodes_fts_content'(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, c0, c1, c2)
CREATE TABLE 'fs_nodes_fts_data'(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, block BLOB)
CREATE TABLE 'fs_nodes_fts_docsize'(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, sz BLOB)
CREATE TABLE 'fs_nodes_fts_idx'(segid, term, pgno, PRIMARY KEY(segid, term)) WITHOUT ROWID

CREATE TABLE fs_path_state (
    path TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    last_change_revision INTEGER NOT NULL
)
CREATE TABLE fs_rebuild_receipts (phase TEXT NOT NULL, cursor TEXT NOT NULL, page_json TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(phase,cursor))
CREATE TABLE fs_rebuild_state (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(id=1), source_guard TEXT NOT NULL, copy_done INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, verify_done INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)
CREATE TABLE fs_search_metadata (node_row_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, title TEXT NOT NULL, shared INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(shared IN (0,1)), summary TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE learning_publication_commits (
    operation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    request_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    result_json TEXT NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE schema_migrations (
    version TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    applied_at INTEGER NOT NULL
)

CREATE TRIGGER fs_node_revision_update AFTER UPDATE ON fs_nodes
WHEN OLD.path != NEW.path OR OLD.kind != NEW.kind OR OLD.content != NEW.content OR OLD.created_at != NEW.created_at OR OLD.updated_at != NEW.updated_at OR OLD.etag != NEW.etag OR OLD.metadata_json != NEW.metadata_json
BEGIN
    INSERT INTO fs_node_revisions(node_id,path,kind,content,created_at,updated_at,etag,metadata_json,deleted)
    SELECT node_id,NEW.path,NEW.kind,NEW.content,NEW.created_at,NEW.updated_at,NEW.etag,NEW.metadata_json,0
    FROM fs_node_identities WHERE current_row_id=NEW.id;
END

CREATE VIEW fs_search_content AS SELECT n.id,n.path,n.kind,COALESCE(m.title,n.name,n.path) AS title,CASE WHEN m.shared=1 THEN m.summary ELSE n.content END AS content FROM fs_nodes n LEFT JOIN fs_search_metadata m ON m.node_row_id=n.id
